newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK ALPHA CREDIT BANK OFFICIALS IN U.S ROADSHOW-SOURCE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK ALPHA CREDIT BANK OFFICIALS IN U.S ROADSHOW-SOURCE.

text.p: A group of high-level officials from private Alpha Credit Bank are in a roadshow in the U.S., a source at the bank told Reuters.

The high-level team will stay in the U.S. for about 10 days and is scheduled to hold a series of meetings with banks, funds and other investors who have shown interest in participating in the bank's upcoming rights issue, the source said.

Alpha Credit Bank President Yannis Costopoulos has been in the United States since last week and is expected to show up in today's opening of "The Glory of Byzantium" exhibition at New York's Metropolitan Museum.
